claim: Globally, the IEA identifies data centres as the smallest of four major electricity-demand growth drivers: industrial output growth, electric vehicles, space cooling, and data centres.
shortLabel: Globally, data centres are not the largest growth driver
displayValue: Smallest of the four major global growth drivers
comparisonContext: This comparison makes the regional asymmetry clearer: moderate globally, much sharper in the United States.
scopeNote: Global comparison. The U.S. picture is much more concentrated and should be treated separately.
